race.comment: PRAY FOR ELEGANCE (5) has been a beaten favourite in both of his starts to date, and has needed plenty of experience at the jump-outs to go along with those performances. He cops a tricky gate second up after finishing runner-up at Wangaratta 11 days ago when resuming from a spell. He is good enough to go one better. MAGNUS MAXIMUS (3) has been to the fore at a couple of jump-outs prior to finishing fifth fresh up as the favourite at Wagga 4 weeks ago. He wouldn't mind some easing of the track here, and he is worth another chance. Follow your money. ORDINARY STAR (4) bolted in at a Wagga trial before finishing fourth as a warm favourite on debut at Albury nearly 7 weeks ago. He has won an Albury trial since then, and with the aid of the pole position, he will be hard to hold out. AZKA VELOCE (7) is on debut, and has shown enough at the jump-outs to be competitive in this. Watch the market moves.
